horizons_subtitle: From the future you imagine to the next step you choose.
quarter_subtitle: Objectives concrete enough to achieve in a month.
achievements_subtitle: Take a moment to see how far you have come.
archives_subtitle: Goals set aside remain available, along with their history.
settings_subtitle: Choose the timezone that determines your accomplishment quarter.
busy_leave: Saving is in progress. Please wait a moment.
guide_ten_year: Dare to choose a direction. What would you like your life to look like in 10 years? A title is enough to start.
guide_three_year: Make your vision tangible. What change do you want to see within 3 years, and why does it matter?
guide_annual: Choose your step forward this year. What concrete outcome will show that you have made progress?
guide_quarterly: Take action. Define an outcome achievable within one month, a first action and at least one measurable key result.
example_ten_year: E.g. Make a living from my business and keep time for loved ones
example_three_year: E.g. Build a sustainable independent business
example_annual: E.g. Validate my offer with my first customers
example_quarterly: E.g. Test an offer with 5 customers in November
empty_body: Write down what matters to you. Your goals will take shape, one horizon at a time.
empty_column: Room for your next step forward.
empty_achievements_body: Complete an objective to find it here, in the quarter when you achieved it.
hero_title: The future is built one step at a time.
hero_body: Keep your vision in sight. Focus your energy on a step within reach.
drag: Drag {{title}}. Move controls are also available.
parent_hint: The link is optional: same area and immediately longer horizon.
title: Your objective
why: Why does this matter to you?
first_action: What is your very first action?
month_hint: At most one month, ending the day before the same date next month. The planned quarter comes from the start date.
dates_hint: Dates are optional at this horizon. Fill in both, or neither.
key_results_hint: Measure an outcome, not an intention. A target below the starting value tracks a reduction.
required_hint: Fields marked * are required for this horizon.
complete_hint: Your key results are reached. This accomplishment will join the current quarter.
complete_pending: Reach every key result to complete this objective.
completion_message: Well done! Your objective joins {{quarter}}. Every step counts.
snapshot_hint: Results saved at completion. Later edits do not change this record.
timezone_hint: E.g. Europe/Paris. Recorded accomplishments keep their original quarter.
quests_hint: An objective completed, a key result reached: every step helps you level up.
not_found: This objective is no longer available.
